source.map_area_convention: [left,top,right,bottom], right/bottom exclusive; original icon-image pixels, x right, y down
source.geometry_convention: Clockwise y-down polygons, not repeated closed vertex; simplified visible roof/main-structure footprints; heights above local ground/platform
source.rotation_convention: Pad rotation_deg: clockwise from +x to first polygon edge, modulo 180; a drawing reference, not a pad class or in-game heading

scale.how: One shared X/Y scale for the whole source image, fitted by least squares in metres to the listed independent visible pad-side controls; uniform fallback when directional scales are not identifiable or would require excessive stretch.
scale.basis: User-confirmed classes, user working dimensions Large170x90m, Medium135x70m, Small70x50m.
limitations: A confirmed class does not identify a precise mechanical deck boundary: traced paint/apron envelopes are approximate.
One shared transform retains residuals at individual pads. Reference dimensions are not forced independently on each pad.
Reconstructed hidden edges are inferred, not additional calibration observations. Negative/out-of-image pixels are permitted only for documented reconstructions.
Camera perspective, roof parallax and terrain can cause local differences; estimates are unsuitable for survey accuracy.
No statistical confidence interval is claimed. Roof heights and floor estimates are preserved.

fingerprint.description: A single HAB northwest of PWR and a tall-dish CMD borders two pads, while a large contiguous IND/LAB/PROC factory roof complex fills the southeast with tanks, pipes and service paths.

buildings.label: HAB
buildings.notes: HAB main roof cluster, excluding surrounding curved ground apron and its shadow. Height/floors are LOW exterior visual estimates, not measured elevations or verified interiors.
buildings.height_estimate_basis: Side view shows a low accommodation volume; metric value is coarse and qualitative.

buildings.label: CMD
buildings.notes: Single-storey low CMD body/main roof. The large mounted dish has its own outline and separate height estimate; the broad black western dish shadow is not encoded. Height/floors are LOW exterior visual estimates, not measured elevations or verified interiors.

height_estimate_basis.basis: Visible front doorway and low single-storey wall proportions distinguish the main roof from tall antenna. No pixel-to-metre calibration or photogrammetry is available. Six metres is a coarse exterior-family estimate.
height_estimate_basis.analogue_scope: Use the low main CMD roof as analogue independently of antenna height; same prefab CMD in Industrial 5 should not inherit total dish height as roof height.

buildings.label: PWR
buildings.notes: Stepped PWR main body with a separate raised circular machinery assembly. Height/floors are LOW exterior visual estimates, not measured elevations or verified interiors.

height_estimate_basis.basis: Visible tall machinery-building exterior, compared qualitatively with neighbouring door/roof proportions. Machinery top is higher than main roof and recorded separately.

buildings.label: IND
buildings.notes: One contiguous factory roof/main-structure envelope bearing LAB, IND and two PROC labels. Shared roof labels are preserved without invented room divisions. Some attached exterior tank platforms extend outside this simplified envelope as details. Bottom central outlet/structure clips legend. Height/floors are LOW exterior visual estimates, not measured elevations or verified interiors.

height_estimate_basis.basis: Factory main bays appear taller than nearby low utility roofs. Two nominal floors are a coarse estimate; the same height could contain one tall industrial bay. Lower annexes appear about 5â€“6 m and are not split into invented rooms.

buildings.notes: Unlabelled L-shaped fixed service roof west of northern pad; outdoor L0 terminal belongs to this unit. Height/floors are LOW exterior visual estimates, not measured elevations or verified interiors.

outline_reconstruction.how: Keep the visible lower long pad boundary from [591,187] to [1343,158], extend perpendicular to that boundary toward negative y, and reconstruct a full rectangle using the agreed Large pad 170:90 length-to-width ratio. Raven photograph shows the whole isolated rectangular apron and confirms orientation, long-axis proportions and location; it is an angled image and does not independently supply hidden original-image pixel corners. previous_scale.how: Pad-constrained similarity using one independently inspected small landing-target centre plus eight distributed external airlock controls spanning HAB,CMD,PWR,and the large industrial complex. No assumed physical pad size.
previous_scale.basis: Visually matched SrvSurvey telemetry-based metric layout: verified pad classes/positions with roof or physical-feature checks. Physical S/M/L pad deck dimensions are not treated as officially specified.
previous_scale.limitations: Approximate uniform horizontal scale; camera perspective, terrain, roof parallax and cropped/obscured landing targets limit accuracy. Range is a practical judgement, not a statistical confidence interval.

limits: Whole-image scalar remains approximate: roof envelopes differ from ground footprints through eaves, height and perspective.

outline_reconstruction.how: Keep the visible lower long pad boundary from [591,187] to [1343,158], extend perpendicular to that boundary toward negative y, and reconstruct a full rectangle using the agreed Large pad 170:90 length-to-width ratio. Raven photograph shows the whole isolated rectangular apron and confirms orientation, long-axis proportions and location; it is an angled image and does not independently supply hidden original-image pixel corners. Hidden depth is finally inferred from the agreed pad dimension under the independently fitted image transform. It is not a scale control. The earlier Raven/aspect-based proposal is retained separately as uncertain diagnostic evidence.

geometry_m.superseded_note: Kept for traceability. site_m holds the plan fitted to SrvSurvey's measured positions, in SrvSurvey's site frame.

frame.origin: Settlement position from the journal (ApproachSettlement Latitude/Longitude), as SrvSurvey uses it
frame.heading: Site heading = ship heading while docked on pad 1, or ship heading minus that pad's rotation_deg on any other pad (SrvSurvey HumanSiteData).
frame.to_world: bearing = heading + atan2(x, y); east = x*cos(h) + y*sin(h); north = -x*sin(h) + y*cos(h)
frame.rotation_convention: rotation_deg and rot_deg are clockwise from +y
frame.floor_convention: SrvSurvey floors: 1 = ground floor, 2 = one floor up, 3 = two floors up. SrvSurvey also uses 0: on every combat-zone point and on a few others, where its meaning isn't documented; those are copied as given. floor_basis says where each floor came from: srvsurvey, or icon carets (the plan's ^ marks, no caret = ground floor). plan_floor keeps the plan's reading where SrvSurvey's differs.
frame.access_convention: Security level 0-3: SrvSurvey's level where matched, otherwise the plan's printed number
frame.source_convention: plan = only on the plan; srvsurvey = only in SrvSurvey; plan+srvsurvey = both, at SrvSurvey's position

site_m.pixel_to_site_note: [X, Y, W] = M . [px, py, 1]; site = (X/W, Y/W). Third row is [0, 0, 1] for a uniform fit.
